name: komdosh-dev-revealer
description: Retrieval before invention — two ladders, one discipline: answer from a real source, cite it, and name the gaps instead of filling them. /reveal <query> surfaces accumulated project knowledge (ADRs, specs, plans, code-embedded DECISION/RATIONALE comments, commit archaeology, and any RAG/MCP knowledge base wired up — codebase-memory, Confluence/Notion/Linear, context7, ref-context) in survey / decision-trace / gap-find modes. /doc-reveal <symbol|topic|library> resolves source documentation cheapest-first (in-repo KDoc/Javadoc → project docs → local cache → MCP → canonical web docs → pre-indexed JAR listings → decompilation as a last resort), caching results so repeats are instant. 2 agents · 2 commands · 2 skills · 1 rule. Read-only on project source; degrades gracefully when no MCP is configured.
